non-blocking: the summary states '15 of the 485 rewritten names sit below the 0.85 publishing threshold' while four of the fifteen carry no documentation score at all (phases.scores.held has score null for 4 of 15, as the table below distinguishes), so unmeasured names are counted as measured-below.

non-blocking: the planted control's expected reading (population_form_count 2, control_form_count 1) is recorded, never asserted, and phase_planted exits 0 whatever it finds, so the regression the run itself hit on its first attempt would let a later run record family_divergent_count 0 and still exit 0.

non-blocking: the page, JSON and instrument filenames carry the plan abbreviation 'sdbc-', which the naming rule forbids in source paths; the declared write grants fixed those names, so the defect belongs to the grant rather than to this worker.
